game_title: Mixed Type Oracle – Eruption Watch Streak
game_concept: A card battler set in Mt. Pyre – Eruption Watch, the volcano watchtower: the forge smith must handle ash wraiths while practicing data types & operators. Core idea – Mixed Type Oracle: Predict the result or error of mixed-type expressions before ash wraiths spring the trap.
theme: Mt. Pyre – Eruption Watch: the volcano watchtower
core_gameplay_loop: In Eruption Watch, repeat each round: Predict the result or error of mixed-type expressions before ash wraiths spring the trap. Each round poses one decision; a wrong answer breaks the streak. Then check the predictions value and advance.
player_objective: Chain 11 consecutive correct decisions about predictions to power up the forge smith and open the lava bridge.
controls: Mouse/touch: drag code blocks into the editor panel; SPACE runs the code; keys 1-4 pick answers.
lose_condition: lives reach 0 (each wrong decision costs a life and resets the streak).
learning_alignment: Week 2 – Data Types & Operators | Level 9 (extended tier): Mixed Type Oracle
assets_style: pixel-art volcano: purple-black rock, glowing lava rivers, orange ember light, drifting ash; flat Kenney-style sprites; low war drums, rumbling bass and crackling fire effects
